title: Timeline Display
content: Build vertical timeline component. Structure: list of events with dates and descriptions. Visual: vertical line with nodes at each event. Position: alternating left/right or all on one side. Node icons: custom icon per event type. Date display: formatted date or relative time. Content: title, description, optional image or link. Connector: line connecting events. Animation: fade/slide in as scrolled into view. Colors: different colors for event types. Responsive: adjust layout for mobile. Loading: skeleton for loading state.

variants.simple: Create vertical timeline for events or history.
variants.detailed: Build vertical timeline component. Structure: list of events with dates and descriptions. Visual: vertical line with nodes at each event. Position: alternating left/right or all on one side. Node icons: custom icon per event type. Date display: formatted date or relative time. Content: title, description, optional image or link. Connector: line connecting events. Animation: fade/slide in as scrolled into view. Colors: different colors for event types. Responsive: adjust layout for mobile. Loading: skeleton for loading state.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive vertical timeline component for event history. Structure: chronological list of events, each with: timestamp, title, description, optional icon, optional image/media, optional link. Visual elements: vertical line (1-2px, gray-200) as connector, nodes/circles at each event (w-3 h-3 rounded-full), horizontal connector from line to card. Layout options: single-sided (all events on right of line), alternating (events alternate left/right), configurable alignment. Node customization: icon inside node for event type (CheckCircle for completed, Clock for scheduled, Star for milestone), color based on status or type. Date display: formatted date (Dec 15, 2024), relative time (2 days ago), or grouped by year/month. Card content: title (font-semibold), description (text-gray-600), media (image, video preview), action links, tags/badges. Animation: events animate in on scroll (opacity-0 translate-y-4 to visible), staggered delay for multiple visible items. Direction: vertical by default, horizontal variant for process flows. Colors: color-coded by event type (green for positive, red for negative, blue for info). Responsive: on mobile, switch to single-sided, compact spacing. Loading: skeleton placeholders maintaining layout structure. Filter/expand: optionally filter by event type, show/hide older events. Current marker: highlight "now" position on ongoing timeline. Accessibility: list semantics (ol/li), dates as time element with datetime attribute.
